rules.path: the unit REFUSES itself (exit 3, VALIDITY census_path FAIL) when any config's compiled MMA path is not the predicate's (wgmma iff BLOCK_M % 64 == 0 and num_warps % 4 == 0): every v4 law is per path
rules.occupancy_read_not_fitted: v4 reads each (tile, GEMM)'s CTAs per SM from the census of the model it prices; the geometry's co-residency window W_c = 132 x that occupancy
rules.re_key (design-tile-review 9.11): a rental-A counter page whose recorded launch__occupancy_limit_* minimum differs from the census (integers, exact) is scored at its recorded occupancy (rental 4's re-key rule) and printed; the census value stays v4's for every other page
rules.rental_B_scope (design-tile-review 9.11): rental B re-reads the census on its own board (a tilecensus unit, compile only; score_tileB.census_check). A (model, tile) whose rental-B occupancy differs from rental A's census on either GEMM has its predictions NOT SCORED on every page of that (model, tile); a missing or refused rental-B census leaves every page NOT SCORED
rules.path_mismatch_is_a_STOP (build-tile-revi: a census that refuses (MMA path mismatch) or is missing STOPS rental B (tileB-stop) and finalise.py refuses: never a fallback to the design occupancy
mechanical_steps: every occupancy is read by tcommon.occupancy_of (the census, else the shared-memory rule): `rowkeys_tile.py --census-score <census.score.json>` re-prices the row-key rows and `register.py --census-score <census.score.json>` rebuilds every registration at the census occupancy before rental B is finalised; no number is edited by hand
v4's wavefronts (mma.sync) and wgmma counts (wgmma) are the census's; the design estimates above are replaced
rules.registers: printed, not gating (the occupancy is what v4 reads)

scorer_ambiguities.2 F-cyc against F-step: F-step (v3's form) is registered; F-cyc replaces it only when, on the 64x128 w8 pages, it is nearer the measured F on both GEMMs and F-step misses by more than 3 se on one (tcommon.f_form_rule)
scorer_ambiguities.3 eta_mma: per clock (Luo Table 11, 0.991), per instruction by Table 9's ratios: 0.983 (m64n128k16, 128x128 w8), 0.965 (m64n64k16, 64x128); H800 PCIe, FP16; BF16 on GH200 assumed equal; rival Table 9's chip-relative 0.872 / 0.857
scorer_ambiguities.4 tA-floor: the test statistic is u = S c + F per (model, GEMM), within 3%; cells are the NATIVE and SHARED cells at n 4..9 whose own GEMM reads DRAM at no more than 0.5 x 4022 GB/s; a dropped w4 page changes nothing (printed only); at 128x128 v4cal and v4 are the same model
scorer_ambiguities.5 the NAMED rule's rows, and the default: every scored w1 row of the G-1 byte pages (uniform, balanced and skewed, NATIVE and SHARED); nothing NAMED gives CLAMP, not v3

scorer_ambiguities.8 tA-rep dropped: rental 3's 0.18% feeds the rivals' se, tA-dead's z and the power at finalisation
